The Downtown Urban Renewal District has brought renewed energy into the heart of the city by providing support for small businesses, investing in critical infrastructure improvements and spurring economic growth. As Meridian’s original urban renewal district, Downtown has been transformed into a vibrant destination for dining, shopping, and community gatherings.
